answer: The strongest single control I know for this is TPM quote with PCR values bound to the epoch, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Faking 704 identities means 704 fresh proofs and 81664 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One pulse of signal, one island of cost, one basalt of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
